newsitem.title: USA: Northern Trust raises share buy-back amount.
newsitem.headline: Northern Trust raises share buy-back amount.

text.p: Northern Trust Corp said Tuesday its board of directors raised the common stock buy-back authorization by about 2.1 million shares.
This allows the repurchase of up to an aggregate of 2.5 million shares, or 5.0 million shares on a post-split basis.
The shares may be purchased from time to time in the open market, and would be used for general corporate purposes, the banking company said.
The company has repurchased about 3.6 million shares, or 7.2 million on a split-adjusted basis, since its authorization was last increased in 1994.
Earlier, Northern Trust declared a two-for-one stock split and increased its quarterly dividend by 16.1 percent to $0.18 a share on a split-adjusted basis.
